say:1:1121140001:1.text: Thank goodness, Dura's Statue is finally back!
say:1:1121140001:1.source_cn: 太好了，女神像终于回来啦！

say:2:1121140002:1.text: Valen, you guys did a fine job! I'll give you a good rating just this time!
say:2:1121140002:1.source_cn: 维伦你们干得还不错嘛，仅这一次，我可以给你们好评价！

say:3:1121140003:1.text: We only helped with moving the statue. Most of the credit goes to <style="stress"><player_name></style> and this lady here.
say:3:1121140003:1.source_cn: 骑士团只有苦劳，功劳其实全在<style=stress...
say:3:1121140003:1.male: We only helped with moving the statue. Most of the credit goes to <style="stress"><player_name></style> and this lady here.
say:3:1121140003:1.female: We only helped with moving the statue. Most of the credit goes to <style="stress"><player_name></style> and this lady here.

say:7:1121140005:1.text: I remember now—some Hypogeans take pleasure in mocking the mortals, while some survive by devouring flames.
say:7:1121140005:1.source_cn: 我想起来了，有些恶魔以嘲弄世人为乐，有些恶魔以吞噬火焰为生。

say:8:1121140006:1.text: And the one I pursued and fought with... he has <style="highlight">an unusual obsession with the divinities</style>. That's probably why he targeted the Dura's Statue and Sun Temple.
say:8:1121140006:1.source_cn: 而我之前追击交手的那一个……他<style=highl...

choice_prompt:9:1121140006.text: And the one I pursued and fought with... he has <style="highlight">an unusual obsession with the divinities</style>. That's probably why he targeted the Dura's Statue and Sun Temple.
choice_prompt:9:1121140006.source_cn: 而我之前追击交手的那一个……他<style=highlight>对于诸神有一种异常的偏执</style>。或许这就是他选择对艾雅神像及日神殿下手的原因。

say:10:1121140007:1.text: Sorry, this is all I can recall right now.
say:10:1121140007:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我能想起来的有限。

say:11:1121140008:1.text: What happened during the battle with the Hypogean and how I lost my memory is still a blur in my mind...
say:11:1121140008:1.source_cn: 和那个恶魔的战斗中发生了什么，又怎样失去了记忆，现在还...

say:12:1121140009:1.text: Don't worry! You're slowly recovering, Chippy is sure you'll remember everything in no time!
say:12:1121140009:1.source_cn: 没关系，塔琳小姐，你已经在慢慢恢复，肯定很快就能想起全...

say:13:1121140010:1.text: Exactly! This is a positive sign! If only <style="stress"><player_name></style> could recover his memory soon too...
say:13:1121140010:1.source_cn: 没错没错，这是好兆头！要是<style=stress>...
say:13:1121140010:1.male: Exactly! This is a positive sign! If only <style="stress"><player_name></style> could recover his memory soon too...
say:13:1121140010:1.female: Exactly! This is a positive sign! If only <style="stress"><player_name></style> could recover her memory soon too...

say:14:1121140011:1.text: Thank you for putting up with me and being by my side.
say:14:1121140011:1.source_cn: 也要感谢你们的宽容和陪伴。这段时间，我会再努力试着回想。

say:15:1121140012:1.text: Hopefully, I'll get to that Hypogean soon.
say:15:1121140012:1.source_cn: 希望能早日找到那个恶魔的真身。

say:18:1121140013:1.text: This has been quite a mission. General Hogan said he would hold a <style="highlight">celebration dinner for us at Traveler's Light tonight</style>.
say:18:1121140013:1.source_cn: 真不容易啊。霍根将军说，<style=highligh...

say:19:1121140014:1.text: You should come! This is a rare chance to enjoy a meal on his tab!
say:19:1121140014:1.source_cn: 你们一定记得来，这可是难得蹭他吃的的机会！

say:20:1121140015:1.text: Miss Talene... I mean, Archon Talene, you've cleared your name. It might not be my place to say this, but you're free to go now.
say:20:1121140015:1.source_cn: 塔琳女士——不，塔琳殿下，你身上的嫌疑也洗清了。虽然这...

say:21:1121140016:1.text: I'm merely going through the formalities, please don't hold it against me!
say:21:1121140016:1.source_cn: 这些都是例行公事的话，请见谅！

say:22:1121140017:1.text: You're just doing your job. There's no need to apologize.
say:22:1121140017:1.source_cn: 你们只是在履行职责而已。不必道歉。

say:23:1121140018:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll spend some time roaming around town and nearby villages next. Some sightseeing might help me remember more things.
